main_text.l: PSALMVS VI. CONSTAT
x. versibus Heb.totidem Latinis.
1. Parce Deus flammásque tui cōpesce furoris /
Verberaque iratus sæua remitte mihi.
2. Affer opem medicam, perij nisi protinus adsis: /
Luxata immodico membra dolore fremunt.
3. Sunt venæ exiles, sunt offa exhausta medullis, /
Mes quoq; in ægrotis artubus ægra magis.
4. Sat, sat multa tuli, in te spes est vna salutis: /
Heu sanes vno mēbra animámque modo.
5. Si tēdam ad tumulū, quis te laudabit humatus? /
Viuus enim laudes & tua facta canam.
6. Hei mihi! confenuit præ morbis corpus anhelū, /
En largo fletus flumine strata madent.
7. Infomnes oculi lachrymis stillantibus arent, /
Natiuum exuxit languor ab ore decus.
8. Lurida, trux facies est, tāquā exangue cadauer: /
Sed miserere mei pro bonitate tua.
9. Ite procul praui, Domino soteria soluam, /
Languidulis succum reftituétque genis.
10. Cedite vos hostes, pudibundáque vertite terga: /
Næque meo Dominus nomine bella gerit.

page.notes: The line "Heb.totidem" is printed as such. Several words carry doubtful readings in this scan ("Mes quoq;", "Heu sanes", "Natiuum", "Si tēdam"), and the line "Mes quoq;" may read differently; these are copied as best seen. The ornament at the foot is a printer's ornament, not text. Verse 4 "Heu sanes" may be "Heu sanes" or "Heu fanes" in the original; copied as "sanes". The page furniture (running head "CANTICA SACRA", page number 237) is as printed.
